Chapter 1274: 26: Wait A Moment

Chapter 1274: Chapter 26: Wait a Moment

“So the Master of Wu Shan doesn’t require challengers to defeat them, that’s simply impossible.”

The golden figure said.

Even those privileged eternal sons, when encountering one of the figures in these three colossal paintings, would be overpowered, let alone facing all three?

Especially the last one, which the Master of Wu Shan modeled after the Lord of Heaven Light.

The Lord of Heaven Light is not only the mightiest eternal lord in this world, but also the most mysterious eternal lord.

No one knows about the past of the Lord of Heaven Light, only that as soon as he appeared, he was already an eternal lord. All other eternal lords, including the Master of Wu Shan, were strictly speaking, beneficiaries of the Lord of Heaven Light.

Even the Rune Dao was passed on by the Lord of Heaven Light, and the other eternal lords were not its creators.

“Can I use any means?”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment and asked.

“Naturally.”

“Regardless of what means you use, as long as it stems from your own strength, if you can walk into the central entrance of the world, you pass the test.”

The golden figure said, “There are no restrictions.”

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded lightly.

“You can listen to my advice, or not.”

The golden figure added. In his view, Lin Yuan’s only hope of passing the test lies in completely transcending the spatiotemporal fusion rule.

But it was just advice, the golden figure couldn’t force Lin Yuan to follow it.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan looked at the three colossal paintings, “Can I try it now?”

“You can.”

The golden figure was unsurprised.

Whether they pass or not, the challengers ahead all first attempted to engage with the powerful figures in the paintings.

After all, these three colossal paintings were considered by the Master of Wu Shan to represent the limits of the Third Realm, even if not opponents, they could at least witness them.

There’s no danger anyway.

“Go ahead.”

The golden figure watched Lin Yuan. “Approach within ten thousand miles of the entrance, and the figure from the first painting will emerge, within a million miles, the figure from the second painting will emerge, within a hundred thousand miles, the figure from the third painting will emerge.”

Simply put, the closer you get to the entrance, the greater the obstruction you face, especially within a hundred thousand miles of the entrance, where figures from all three paintings will intervene.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan immediately flew toward the center of the world.

The closer he got, the more he could feel the immense and unbelievable enormity of the paintings.

“These figures in the three paintings were created by the Master of Wu Shan, meaning brought into existence from thin air?” Lin Yuan marveled slightly; at least the six ancestors of the first origin world didn’t have such capabilities.

Of course, every thirteenth-level life form possesses different strengths; the Master of Wu Shan specializes in the way of painting, which essentially is creating from the void.

In terms of destructive power though, compared to other eternal lords, maybe a bit inferior?

Quickly.

Lin Yuan arrived within ten thousand miles of the entrance.

With a rustle.

The first colossal painting unfurled, suddenly stirring delicate ripples, the image akin to a water surface.

The gold-armored youth, as if coming to life, moved his hands, taking a step out of the painting.

“You are the three-thousand-six-hundred-and-thirty-fifth challenger.”

The gold-armored youth lazily looked at Lin Yuan, shaking his head, “But it seems you won’t even be able to get past me.”

It takes reaching within a million miles of the entrance to provoke the second figure into action.

Meanwhile, the gold-armored youth would prevent Lin Yuan from approaching.

“Let’s give it a try.”

Lin Yuan’s expression turned slightly grave; confronting a being on par with the ‘Abyss Dragon’, Lin Yuan was encountering this for the first time.

“Hahaha.”

The gold-armored youth laughed, as his aura suddenly skyrocketed, golden armor glowing with billions of runes, causing the surrounding space-time to solidify and compress.

“This type of Rune Dao?”

Lin Yuan scrutinized, realizing the gold-armored youth’s mastery of the Rune Dao far surpassed any of Lin Yuan’s rune inheritances, producing an oppressive aura that nearly shattered space-time into particle form.

“Hold.”

The gold-armored youth raised his right hand, pressing it down toward Lin Yuan.

Immediately, the surrounding space-time transformed into runes, enveloping Lin Yuan in an instant. A common Third Realm transcendenter would be immobilized, then completely suppressed.

Indeed, a typical Third Realm transcendenter wouldn’t even withstand the gold-armored youth’s first move, much less break through.

“Using runes to interpret space-time?”

A trace of peculiar emotion crossed Lin Yuan’s eyes. Stepping back, he easily dodged the youth’s grab.

For a thousand years, Lin Yuan has been continuously comprehending the origin source operations of the first origin world, pushing the space-time fusion rule to its limits. Even without hope of entering the entrance, handling the youth’s move was more than manageable.

“Hm?”

The gold-armored youth was slightly startled, clearly not expecting Lin Yuan to be so ‘slippery’.

“Your space-time comprehension is not bad,” the youth praised before calmly adding, “But it’s still far from enough.”

With a rumble.

The surroundings filled instantly with golden runes.

The runes intertwined and flowed, vaguely forming a massive golden cage.

“This move?”

Lin Yuan regarded it with slight solemnity. Even with his spatial-temporal comprehension, breaking free from this golden cage would require considerable effort, during which the youth’s attacks would have long descended.

Rumble.

Lin Yuan himself transformed directly into an eternal fierce sun. As the Taiyang Divine Spirit, performing such a lethal move wielded immense power.

At the same time.

The Divine Ability ‘World’ also activated in an instant.

The golden cage began to tremble and then shattered with a crash, and in the next moment, the golden-armored boy’s next strike roared forth.

With the shackles of the golden cage gone, Lin Yuan successfully fused into time and space, evading it.

“This technique, I haven’t seen it before?”

The golden-armored boy was slightly astonished. Since the advent of the demonic calamity, throughout the long years, he had seen one challenger after another, but transforming into a fierce sun like Lin Yuan, with such tyrannical conversion and distortion of space-time, was a first.

“Interesting, interesting.”

“But strength is the foundation of everything.”

The golden-armored boy continued his assault, golden runes filling the space-time.

From start to finish, since the golden-armored boy made his move, Lin Yuan had been at a disadvantage.

Not to mention breaking through, even holding on before the golden-armored boy was quite strenuous.

“In this descent, all resources have been prioritized for the true main body, indeed neglecting the cultivation of the two Primordial Spirits.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Whether it was the Taiyin Primordial Spirit or the Taiyang Divine Spirit, neither had developed a particle world, nor had much resources been expended on cultivating the internal universe of the physical body.

The practice of “Infinite Void” did proceed, but reaching the fifth level, it was only comparable to an ordinary Invincible Great Saint or Strongest Venerable.

That is, the Third Realm of this Fang Yuan World.

Yet the golden-armored boy was an existence above the Eternal Son.

Under such circumstances, it was already rare for Lin Yuan as the Taiyang Divine Spirit to persist so long before the golden-armored boy.

Under the golden-armored boy’s full attack, the Third Realm powerhouse, namely Invincible Great Saint and Strongest Venerable, could not withstand it at all and was quickly suppressed.

“Chaos Sun Power…”

Lin Yuan once again transformed into a fierce sun. As the Taiyang Divine Spirit, it was purely solar and could not leverage the Taiyin Dao. Hence, the path of chaos evolution was not a perfect Chaos Taiji, but a singular Chaos Sun.

The fierce sun burned, incinerating the world, and the time-space rapidly changed to all become its domain.

In an instant, even the golden runes from the invisible golden-armored boy in the space-time retreated.

“Such a technique?”

The golden-armored boy, unusually, stopped his hands, carefully observing for a moment, nodding in admiration: “Rare indeed, this kind of chaos evolution power, though extreme, is indeed of great might.”

This Fang Yuan World perceives all things based on runes, similarly comprehending the Dao rules and the path of chaos evolution.

In the eyes of the golden-armored boy, even the singular Chaos Sun Power was astonishing enough.

“With the path you’re on, if cultivated to the limit, you should be able to reach the Eternal Son level.” The golden-armored boy’s tone gradually turned cold: “But now you are far from it.”

“Go back and continue cultivating for a billion years and then come back.”

The golden-armored boy waved a hand, and endless golden runes swept forth again, mighty and imposing, instantly crushing the cosmic exterior of Lin Yuan.

Boom!

Lin Yuan suddenly retreated millions of miles, and only after several breaths did his aura calm down.

As Lin Yuan left the million-mile range, the golden-armored boy turned and walked back out of the giant painting.

The golden runes dispersed, and everything returned to normal.

Only Lin Yuan stood there, his expression immersed in contemplation.

“Relying solely on an untrained Taiyang Divine Spirit, it is indeed challenging to pass the test.”

Lin Yuan concluded that even the golden-armored boy of merely the first giant painting could drive him back, let alone the second and third giant paintings.

“So, how do you feel?”

A golden figure appeared beside him, looking at Lin Yuan with a hint of amazement.

In reality, Lin Yuan’s performance just now against the golden-armored boy had already exceeded the golden figure’s expectations, almost reaching the normal Eternal Son level.

“It’s still according to my suggestion, through sheer strength, you have no hope of passing the test. Only by completely transcending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule can there be a chance.”

The golden figure said.

Indeed, completely transcending the space-time rules was somewhat akin to taking a clever approach to passing the test, as it involved not engaging directly with the powerful figures in the three giant paintings but entirely entering the entrance through transcendent comprehension of space-time.

However, the Master of Wushan did not prohibit such methods, and the golden figure also advised in the direction most likely for Lin Yuan to pass the test.

“Completely transcending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule’s comprehension is too slow.”

Lin Yuan stated honestly.

He indeed felt this method was too slow.

He wasn’t sure whether it would take a thousand years or ten thousand years.

“Too slow?”

The golden figure was slightly stunned.

As long as there’s hope, what does it matter if it takes a billion or ten billion years?

“I still have means unutilized.”

Lin Yuan looked at the golden figure and said, “Wait for a moment.”

…

Qingyun Sacred Mountain, deep within the Qingyun Institute.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, stood up slowly, and then took a step forward.

Time and space were instantly torn apart, with the terrifying power of the physical body and the majestic inner cosmos aura penetrating everything.

Beyond the test space, around that valley, runes lit up instantaneously, space-time unfolded, as if resisting the intrusion of an unfathomable presence.

The entire test space trembled.

Shaking incessantly.
